subject: Upcoming Company Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I'm excited to announce that our annual team building event is coming up on Friday, March 25th. The event will include team-building activities, games, and a delicious catered lunch. Please RSVP by March 10th so we can finalize arrangements. This is a great opportunity for us to bond outside of work and strengthen our team spirit. Looking forward to seeing everyone there! Best, [Your Name]
